messages.content: Dukaan pe bhaiya se bolna hai ki "yeh shirt thodi badi hai, chhota size dikhao". English mein kya bolun?
You can say: "This shirt is a little big for me. Could you show me a smaller size, please?" Use "Could you" to sound polite.
Boss ko mail likhna hai ki main kal office nahi aa paunga kyunki ghar mein function hai. Ek line chahiye.
Try this: "Dear Sir, I will not be able to come to the office tomorrow because of a family function. Please grant me a day's leave." It is short, polite and clear.
My son teacher ko bolna chahta hai "Mam, mujhe samajh nahi aaya, please dobara samjhaiye". How he can say in English?
He can say: "Ma'am, I did not understand. Could you please explain it once more?" Asking this way is polite, and teachers like it when students ask.
Hospital ke reception pe bolna hai ki mera Dr. Rao ke saath 11 baje ka appointment hai. English?
At the reception you can say: "Good morning. I have an appointment with Dr. Rao at eleven o'clock." Then give your name if they ask for it.
Bank counter pe passbook update karwana hai. Kaise bolun?
Say: "Hello, I would like to get my passbook updated, please." If the clerk asks for it, hand over the passbook and say, "Here it is."
Station pe kisi se poochna hai ki Pune jaane wali train kaun se platform pe aayegi. English mein?
You can ask: "Excuse me, which platform does the train to Pune come to?" Or a shorter way: "Excuse me, where can I find the Pune train?"
Phone pe bolna hai "Main Anil bol raha hoon, kya Mr. Shah se baat ho sakti hai?"
Say: "Hello, this is Anil speaking. May I speak to Mr. Shah, please?" In English we say "this is Anil speaking", not "I am Anil".
Diwali pe apne boss ko wish karna hai. Short aur formal line chahiye.
Try: "Wishing you and your family a happy and bright Diwali, Sir." If you want it a little warmer, add: "May the year ahead bring you good health and happiness."
Cousin ki shaadi hai. Dulhan ko congratulate karna hai English mein, thoda pyara sa.
You can say: "Congratulations on your wedding! You look lovely today, and I wish you and your husband a lifetime of happiness together."
Is sentence ko English mein bata do: "Mujhe kal subah jaldi uthna hai."
In English: "I have to wake up early tomorrow morning." You can also say "I need to get up early tomorrow."
"Woh abhi tak ghar nahi pahuncha" ka English kya hoga?
It is: "He has not reached home yet." We use "has not ... yet" for something that is still not done at the time of speaking.
"Baarish ki wajah se match cancel ho gaya." English me kaise likhein?
Write: "The match was cancelled because of the rain." You can also say "The match was called off due to rain."
Translate this: "Tum itne dino se kahan the?"
In English: "Where have you been all these days?" Or, more simply, "Where have you been for so long?"
Mummy ne kaha "Khana kha ke hi jaana." English sentence kya hoga?
It is: "Eat before you leave." If you want to sound a little stronger, say: "Do not go without eating something first."
I am knowing him since five years. Is this right?
Not quite. Say: "I have known him for five years." Why: "know" does not usually take the -ing form, and "for" is used with a length of time, while "since" is used with a starting point.
Please check my sentence: "She don't likes spicy food."
Correct form: "She doesn't like spicy food." Why: with "she" we use "doesn't", and after "doesn't" the main verb stays in its base form, so "likes" becomes "like".
Yesterday I go to market and buyed vegetables. Sahi hai kya?
Not yet. Say: "Yesterday I went to the market and bought vegetables." Why: "go" and "buy" are irregular verbs, so their past forms are "went" and "bought". Also, "the market" needs an article.
He is more taller than me. Please correct.
The correct sentence is: "He is taller than me." Why: "taller" is already a comparative form, so we do not add "more" before it.
I have a doubt in this chapter, can you explain? Teacher said it is wrong.

A better sentence is: "I have a doubt about this chapter" or, more commonly, "I have a question about this chapter." Why: "doubt" means you are not sure something is true, while "question" is the normal word for something you want explained.
Me and my friend is going to cinema tomorrow.
Correct form: "My friend and I are going to the cinema tomorrow." Why: two people need "are", not "is". It is also polite to put the other person first, and "the" comes before "cinema".
Colleague said "Let's circle back on this." Iska matlab kya hai?
It means "let's talk about this again later." The person wants to leave the topic for now and return to it after more thought or information. It is common in offices and is not rude.
My manager wrote "Kindly do the needful." What does it mean? Is it okay English?

It means "please do whatever is necessary to finish this task." It is common in Indian offices, but people in other countries may find it unclear. A clearer way is: "Please process this request and let me know when it is done."
Teacher ne remark likha "Needs improvement". Bura hai kya?

It is not harsh. It means the work is not yet at the expected level and can get better with more effort. It is a gentle way of saying "try harder and fix the weak parts". Ask your teacher which parts to improve.
Principal said "Parents are requested to remain present." Means compulsory?
Yes, in most schools this means parents are expected to come. "Are requested" sounds polite, but the school really wants everyone there. If you cannot attend, tell the class teacher before the day.
Neighbour ko bolna hai "Raat ko music band karo" lekin politely. Kaise?

Try: "Sorry to trouble you, but could you please keep the music low at night? We are finding it hard to sleep." A casual version for a friendly neighbour is: "Hey, could you turn the music down a bit?"
"Give me water" ko polite kaise bolte hain restaurant mein?
You can say: "Could I have some water, please?" or "May I get a glass of water, please?" Both are polite. "Give me water" sounds like an order.
Friend ko casual mein aur interviewer ko formal mein "I am late" kaise bolun?
Casual, to a friend: "I'm running late, sorry!" Formal, to an interviewer: "I apologise for the delay. I will reach in a few minutes." Use the formal one when you do not know the person well.
Sabzi wale se bolna hai ki "Aadha kilo tamatar do aur thoda dhaniya free mein". English?
Say: "Half a kilo of tomatoes, please. And could you add a little coriander too?" Asking for something "free" directly can sound pushy, so "add a little" is softer.
Meeting mein apni baat rakhni hai, "Main kuch bolna chahta hoon." Kaise start karun?
You can start with: "May I say something?" or "If I may, I would like to add a point." Both let you step in politely.
Class mein bahar jaane ki permission lene ke liye kya bolte hain?
Say: "Ma'am, may I go out, please?" Some teachers like the full form: "May I please go to the washroom?" Wait for the teacher to say yes before you leave.
Auto wale ko English mein bolna hai "Meter se chalo, extra paisa nahi dunga".
You can say: "Please go by the meter. I will pay only what it shows." Say it calmly and clearly, and do not raise your voice.
Call pe awaaz kat rahi hai. Unhe kaise bolun ki dobara bolo?
Say: "Sorry, your voice is breaking up. Could you please say that again?" Or: "I cannot hear you clearly. Could you repeat that?"
Dadi ki birthday hai. Card pe likhne ke liye ek pyari English line batao.
Write: "Happy Birthday, Dadi! Your stories and your love make our home special. We love you very much." Keep the card short so the handwriting stays neat.
Eid pe dost ko message bhejna hai. English mein kya likhun?
Write: "Eid Mubarak! May this day bring you joy, peace and lots of sweet moments with your loved ones." You can add your friend's name at the start.
Reception pe poochna hai ki report kab milegi. Kaise puchun?
Ask: "Excuse me, when will my report be ready?" If you want to ask about the day, say: "Could you tell me when I can collect my report?"
Bank mein bolna hai ki mera cheque book khatam ho gayi hai, nayi chahiye. English?
Say: "I have used all the leaves in my cheque book. I would like to request a new one, please." The clerk will tell you what form to fill.
I am having a request, can you please give me one day leave?
A better sentence is: "I have a request. Could you please give me a day off?" Why: "have" is not used with -ing when it means "own" or "hold", and "a day off" or "a day's leave" is the usual phrase.
She said me that she will came tomorrow.

Correct form: "She told me that she would come tomorrow." Why: we say "told me" (or "said to me"), not "said me", and after "would" or "will" the verb stays in its base form, so "came" becomes "come".
Boss ne bola "I will revert by evening." Revert ka matlab to wapas jaana hota hai na?

In most English, "revert" does mean go back, but in Indian offices "I will revert" means "I will reply to you." Other countries may find that confusing. A clearer line is: "I will get back to you by evening."
"Mujhe bhookh lagi hai, kuch halka khane ko milega?" English mein bolo.
In English: "I am hungry. Can I get something light to eat?" The word "light" here means a small, easy meal.
Teacher ko "Aap meri help karo" polite tarike se kaise bolun?
Say: "Could you please help me with this, ma'am?" or "I would be grateful for your help." Add the word "please" and use "could", and it sounds respectful.
Return karna hai kapde, kya bolun? Size fit nahi hua.
You can say: "I bought this yesterday, but the size does not fit. Could I exchange it for another size, please?" Keep the bill with you.
Wrong number lag gaya. Politely kaise bolun?
Say: "Oh, I am sorry. I think I have dialled the wrong number." Then end the call kindly with: "Have a good day."
Colleague ne bola "Please do the needful and revert." Mujhe kuch samajh nahi aaya, kya karna hai?
She is asking you to do what is needed for the task and then reply to her. First complete the job. Then write back: "The work is done. Please tell me if anything more is needed."
Aur agar mujhe kuch pata hi nahi ki needful kya hai to?
Then ask her directly: "Could you tell me exactly what you need from me?" It is always fine to ask for clear steps when an instruction is vague.
Interview mein "Tell me about yourself" ka jawab kaise shuru karun? Main fresher hoon.
Start like this: "Good morning. My name is Neha, and I have just finished my degree in commerce. I enjoy working with numbers and learning new things." Then mention one skill and one goal.
Weakness puchhe to kya bolun?
Pick a small, real weakness and show how you are improving it. For example: "I sometimes take too long to finish small tasks, so now I make a daily list and set time limits."
Hotel ke reception pe check-in karna hai. Kya bolun?
Say: "Hello, I have a booking under the name Arjun Mehta. I would like to check in, please." Keep your ID ready, as they usually ask for it.
Aur kamra thoda shaant chahiye to?
Ask: "Could I have a quiet room, away from the road, if one is available?" Adding "if one is available" keeps it polite.
Holi pe Australian friend ko invite karna hai. Kaise likhun?
Write: "Hi Sam, we are celebrating Holi, the festival of colours, this Sunday at 10 a.m. at my house. Wear old clothes, as we will play with colours. Please come and join us!"
Usko kaise samjhaun ki Holi kya hai?
Say: "Holi is a spring festival in India. People throw coloured powder and water at each other, share sweets and meet family and friends. It celebrates the arrival of spring."
Please tell what is wrong: "I am agree with you."
Correct form: "I agree with you." Why: "agree" is a verb, so we do not use "am" before it.
Aur "I am not agree" kaise bolun?
Say: "I do not agree." Why: for the negative we use "do not" with the base verb, so "I do not agree" is correct.
Bank wale ne bola "Please fill the form in capital letters." Matlab?
It means write every letter in the form as a big letter, like "RAVI KUMAR", not "Ravi Kumar". Banks ask for this so that the writing is easy to read.
Aur "block letters" kya hota hai?
"Block letters" means the same thing: clear, separate, capital letters. Use a pen and write one letter in each box if the form has boxes.
Sir se kehna hai "Aap please mujhe ek chance do." Formal tarike se?
Say: "Sir, I would be grateful if you could give me one more chance." The words "I would be grateful" make the request very respectful.
Aur dost se casual mein?
Say: "Hey, give me one more chance, okay?" It is relaxed and fine with a friend, but do not use it with a teacher or a boss.
Restaurant mein waiter ko bolna hai ki khana kam teekha banaye. English?
Say: "Could you please make it less spicy?" If you want only a little spice, say: "Medium spicy, please."
Post office mein parcel bhejna hai Delhi. Counter pe kya bolun?
Say: "I would like to send this parcel to Delhi. How much will it cost, and how many days will it take?" Keep the address written on the parcel.
Salon mein bolna hai "Baal thode chhote kar do, bas do inch." English?
Say: "Please trim my hair a little, just two inches." "Trim" means to cut a small amount.
Airport pe check-in counter pe bolna hai ki mujhe window seat chahiye.
Say: "Could I have a window seat, please?" If none is left, they may offer an aisle seat, which is next to the walkway.
Library mein librarian se kehna hai ki yeh kitaab ek hafte aur rakhni hai. English?
Say: "Could I keep this book for one more week, please?" The librarian may say "renew". That means extend the loan time.
College office mein poochna hai ki admission ki last date kya hai. Kaise?
Ask: "Excuse me, what is the last date for admission?" You can add: "Is there a form I should fill in?"
Landlord se bolna hai ki geyser kharab hai, theek karwa do. English me polite line?
Say: "Sir, the geyser is not working. Could you please arrange to get it repaired?" If it is urgent, add: "We are facing some trouble without hot water."
Clinic ke reception pe bolna hai ki mujhe doctor se milna hai, pehli baar aaya hoon.
Say: "Hello, this is my first visit. I would like to see the doctor, please." They will ask for your name and phone number to make a file.
Is line ka English batao: "Chai thandi ho gayi, ise garam kar do."
In English: "The tea has gone cold. Please heat it up." You can also say "Could you warm this tea for me?"
"Mere paas time nahi hai, baad mein baat karte hain" ko English mein kaise kahein?
Say: "I don't have time right now. Let's talk later." A softer way is: "I'm a bit busy now. Can we talk later?"
"Usne mujhe galat samjha" English?
In English: "He misunderstood me." Or: "She got me wrong." Use "misunderstood" when writing and "got me wrong" when chatting.
Translate karo: "Mujhe pata nahi tha ki tum aa rahe ho."
In English: "I did not know that you were coming." We use "were coming" because we are talking about the past.
"Kitni der lagegi?" ko shop mein ya office mein English mein kaise bolein?
Ask: "How long will it take?" It works everywhere: in a shop, at a repair centre or at an office counter.
He have two sisters and one brothers. Please fix it.
Correct form: "He has two sisters and one brother." Why: with "he" we use "has", and "one" is followed by a singular noun, so "brothers" becomes "brother".
I am going to home now. Is this correct?
Correct form: "I am going home now." Why: "home" is used here as an adverb, so we do not put "to" before it.
Can you correct: "I didn't went to school yesterday."
Correct form: "I didn't go to school yesterday." Why: after "didn't" the verb takes its base form, so "went" becomes "go". "Didn't" already shows the past.
She is working here since 2019. Sahi hai?
Not quite. Say: "She has been working here since 2019." Why: when an action began in the past and still continues, we use the present perfect continuous, not "is working".
My sister is elder than me by two years. Correct me.
A natural sentence is: "My sister is two years older than me." Why: "elder" is mostly used for family members and not with "than" in modern English, and the number of years comes before "older".
Please check: "Give me your pen, I will return you tomorrow."
Correct form: "Please give me your pen. I will return it to you tomorrow." Why: the thing you return is "it", and we say "return it to you". Adding "please" also makes the request polite.
I like very much this song. Is it wrong?
Yes, the word order is wrong. Say: "I like this song very much." Why: in English, the object ("this song") comes right after the verb, and "very much" goes after it.
Senior ne mail mein likha "Please find attached." Iska kya matlab hai?
It means "I have attached a file to this email, and it is for you to look at." It is a common way to introduce an attachment in a formal email.
Teacher ne bola "Don't be a bookworm." Kya yeh bura hai?
A bookworm is someone who reads a lot. Here the teacher probably means "do not only read; play and meet people too". It is not a harsh remark, but it can sound teasing.
Office mein sabne kaha "He is on leave till further notice." Kab aayega?
"Till further notice" means no return date has been set yet. The office will tell people when it is decided. So the answer is: nobody knows yet.
Notice board pe likha tha "Admission on first-come, first-served basis". Samajh nahi aaya.
It means the people who apply first get the seats first. When all the seats are taken, the rest cannot join. So it is best to apply early.
Friend said "I will ping you." Ping kya hota hai?
"To ping someone" means to send a short message to get their attention. "I will ping you" means "I will message you soon". It is casual, so use it with friends and coworkers, not in a formal letter.
Customer care wale ko "Mera kaam jaldi karo" politely kaise bolun?
Say: "I would be very thankful if you could look into this soon." A simpler version is: "Could you please help me with this as soon as possible?"
Shop pe "kuch aur dikhao" ke liye formal aur casual dono bolo.
Formal: "Could you please show me some other designs?" Casual: "Got anything else?" Use the first with a stranger and the second with a friendly shopkeeper you know well.
Seat chhodne ke liye kisi se kaise bolun? Bus mein bahut thaka hoon.
Ask: "Excuse me, would you mind if I sat here?" if a seat is free, or: "Sorry, could I please have this seat? I am quite tired." Be ready to accept a "no" kindly.
Raksha Bandhan pe bhai ko message likhna hai. Pyara sa.
Write: "Happy Raksha Bandhan, Bhai! Thank you for always standing by me. I am lucky to have a brother like you."
Ganesh Chaturthi pe padosiyon ko prasad dena hai. Kya bolun?
Say: "Happy Ganesh Chaturthi! Please take some prasad. It is a sweet offering from our puja." If they are from another country, "puja" means a prayer ceremony.
Mere chacha ki death hui hai. Condolence message English mein kaise likhun?
Write: "I was very sorry to hear about your uncle. My thoughts are with you and your family. Please accept my deepest sympathies." Keep it short and simple.
Bus conductor se poochna hai ki Shivaji Nagar kab aayega. English?
Ask: "Excuse me, could you tell me when we reach Shivaji Nagar?" You can add: "Please let me know when it comes."
Parent-teacher meeting mein teacher se poochna hai ki mera beta kaisa kar raha hai.
Ask: "How is my son doing in class?" A fuller question is: "Could you tell me how he is doing in studies and with his friends?" It shows that you care about both.
Phone pe bolna hai ki "Aap thoda ruko, main abhi aata hoon." Formal English?
Say: "Could you please hold on for a moment? I will be right with you." On a phone call, "hold on" means wait without hanging up.
Dukaan wale se discount maangna hai. Rude na lage.
Say: "Is there any discount on this?" or "If I buy two, could you give me a better price?" Both are polite. Smile, and accept it if the answer is no.
Colleague ko bolna hai "Yeh kaam meri zimmedari nahi hai". Rude na lage.
Say: "I think this task belongs to the accounts team. Shall I tell you who to ask?" It explains clearly and does not blame anyone.
Aur agar boss ne diya ho wahi kaam?
Say: "Sir, I am already handling two tasks. Could we decide which one comes first?" This shows you are willing to help, but it makes the load clear.
Interview ke end mein "Aap kuch puchna chahte hain?" pe kya bolun?
You can ask: "What would a normal day in this role look like?" or "What skills would help me most in the first three months?" Both show interest in the job.
Aur agar kuch nahi poochna ho?
Say: "Thank you, you have answered my questions already. I appreciate your time." That is polite and ends the interview well.
Teacher ko bolna hai ki bukhar ki wajah se kal nahi aaya. Application likhni hai.
Write: "Respected Ma'am, I could not attend school yesterday because I had a fever. Kindly excuse my absence. Yours obediently, Rahul." A parent can sign the note as well.
Isme "obediently" kyun likhte hain?
It is an old-style closing used in school letters in India. It means "respectfully". Nowadays "Yours sincerely" or "Thank you" is also fine. Check what your school prefers.
Train ticket cancel karwana hai, counter pe kya bolun?
Say: "I would like to cancel this ticket, please. Here is my PNR number." The PNR number is the booking code printed on the ticket.
Refund kitna milega ye kaise puchun?
Ask: "How much money will I get back after cancelling?" Or: "Could you tell me the refund amount, please?"
Navratri mein garba ke liye dost ko invite karna hai. Kya likhun?
Write: "Hi Lisa, would you like to come to garba with us on Saturday evening? It is a folk dance done during Navratri. You do not need to know the steps. We will teach you!"
Aur uski dress ke baare mein kya bolun?
Say: "Wear something colourful and comfortable. Many women wear a chaniya choli and men wear a kurta, but any bright clothes are fine."
She said me "I am feeling hungry". Is it okay?
Close, but "said me" is not correct. Say: "She told me, 'I am feeling hungry'" or "She said, 'I am hungry.'" Why: "tell" takes a person directly, but "say" does not.
Aur "I am feeling hungry" sahi hai?
It is understood, but most people say "I am hungry." Why: "hungry" is a state, so the simple present is more natural than "am feeling".
Boss ne kaha "Let's take this offline." Kya matlab?
It means "let's talk about it separately, not in front of everyone". It usually happens after a meeting, in person or by phone. It is not a punishment.
Aur "Let's park it" ka?
"Let's park it" means "let's stop talking about this for now and keep it for later". The idea is the same as leaving a car in a parking spot.
Meri bahu ko English mein kaise introduce karun mehmanon se?
Say: "This is my daughter-in-law, Priya." In English, a son's wife is a "daughter-in-law", and a daughter's husband is a "son-in-law". Use the first phrase when you introduce her.
Aur apne jeth ko?
Your husband's older brother is your "brother-in-law". English does not separate older and younger. You can say "my husband's elder brother" if you want to be exact.
Class ke bacchon ko "chup raho" ke bajaye kya bolun? Main tutor hoon.
Try: "Please settle down, everyone." or "Let's keep our voices low so that we can all hear." Children respond better to a calm, friendly request.
Casual version bhi chahiye mere cousin ke liye.
For a cousin you can say: "Hey, shh, keep it down a bit!" It is friendly and relaxed. Do not use it in a class.
Mobile repair shop pe "Screen toot gayi hai, kitna lagega?" English mein.
Say: "My phone screen is cracked. How much will it cost to repair?" You can also ask: "How long will it take?"
Ye bhi bolna hai ki pehle price bata do phir kaam karna.
Say: "Please tell me the price first. I will decide after that." This is clear and polite.
Cricket match mein dost ko bolna hai "Catch chhod diya, koi baat nahi, agli baar pakad lena." English?
Say: "You dropped the catch. Never mind, you will get the next one." "Never mind" here means "it is okay, do not worry".
Society meeting mein bolna hai ki parking ki jagah kam hai. Kaise bolun?
Say: "There is not enough parking space for everyone. Could we find a fair way to share it?" Starting with the problem and then asking for a solution keeps the meeting calm.
Mera English bolne mein jhijhak lagti hai. Office mein kaise improve karun?
Start small. Say two or three sentences at each meeting. Write down new words you hear and use them the next day. Mistakes are normal, and most people are happy to help.
One of my friend are coming to the party. Please correct.
Correct form: "One of my friends is coming to the party." Why: after "one of" the noun is plural ("friends"), but the verb agrees with "one", so we use "is".
"Aaj mausam bahut suhana hai" ka English kya hoga?
In English: "The weather is lovely today." You can also say "It is a beautiful day today."
